explanation: The execution contains a provenance fault introduced upstream. Job 1 produced evidence_sources with record_id set to the source id (s01, s02, etc.) instead of the demand record ids (n06-r01, n06-r02, etc.). Job 2 consumed the exact handoff unchanged, so its rank lookup by demand record_id found no matches and all priority rows have upstream_rank 0. This violates the requirement to preserve deterministic source provenance identities and provenance order.
cited_evidence: Job 1 assemble_provenance code appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': ..., 'rank': index}, replacing the demand record_id with source_id.
The downstream input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08 while the needs/coverage record_id values are n06-r01 through n06-r08.
The handoffs for needs and evidence_sources have matching producer_sha256 and consumer_sha256, indicating Job 2 received the upstream artifacts exactly.
The observed Job 2 priorities all show upstream_rank: 0, consistent with failed record_id-based rank lookup against evidence_sources.
